capabilities: Look up a provision by citation form or by words of its text
Insert a ready-made citation at the cursor
Verify every statutory citation in a note against the embedded text
Expose lookup and verification tools to Claude through a local MCP server
Save chosen statutes as vault notes with verification hashes
extras: Desktop only; interface in Brazilian Portuguese; main.js is about 11 MB because the legislation base is embedded uncompressed; no network access and no telemetry; not yet in the community plugin directory, so it is installed via BRAT or by hand.
motivation: The author's stated idea is that the content of an article is not written from memory but copied from a verified base.
problem: Legal provisions quoted from memory cannot be checked inside Obsidian, and there is no built-in source of literal statutory text to cite from.

relations.evidence: É o irmão do Projurista MCP, que faz o mesmo com súmulas e precedentes qualificados.
"Conectar ao Claude Desktop" grava a conexão no arquivo de configuração (com cópia de segurança)
"Copiar comando do Claude Code" e cole no terminal.

summary: Embeds Brazilian federal legislation as literal text to look up, cite and verify statutory provisions in notes and through a local MCP server for Claude.
